item.title: IRGC: Two oil tankers, tugboat catch fire in Strait of Hormuz; two LUCAS drones seized
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has announced that two oil tankers and a tugboat caught fire in separate incidents in the Strait of Hormuz after they attempted to use an unauthorized route, while its electronic warfare unit captured two LUCAS drones.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86313001/IRGC-Two-oil-tankers-tugboat-catch-fire-in-Strait-of-Hormuz

Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has announced that two oil tankers and a tugboat caught fire in separate incidents in the Strait of Hormuz after they attempted to use an unauthorized route, while its electronic warfare unit captured two LUCAS drones.

item.title: Iran sharply reacts to remarks by German FM
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – In response to remarks by the German foreign minister justifying the military aggression by the US and the Israeli regime against Iran, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei has said that by endorsing the aggression of the US and Israel against Iran, the German foreign minister has reduced himself to the level of an apologist for the most heinous war crimes.

item.title: Iran protests IMO’s biased reports on shipping security
item.description: London, IRNA – The Islamic Republic of Iran has criticized the International Maritime Organization (IMO) biased reports on the shipping crisis, stressing that seafarer protection should not be selective and that the difficult conditions facing Iranian seafarers must also be addressed.
